description: Members whose binding is broken in C++, so no correct Lua type exists until the binding is fixed. The type audit reports them as known_binding_bug instead of blocking. Entries name a class, or a container metatable since container classes are generic instantiations. Remove an entry once its binding is fixed.

members.reason: Registered with a nullptr element metatable, so element access calls luaL_getmetatable(L, NULL).
Reads LektorPtrBinding<hand>::get(L, 2), but only LektorValueReadOnlyBinding<hand> is registered, so its metatable name is null.
Checks argument 3 against LektorValueBinding<StringPair>::metaName, but lektor<StringPair> is never registered, so the metatable name is null.
The getter pushes the C++ bool through HandBinding::push while the setter reads a boolean.
